newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures up limit on strong cash ideas.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures up limit on strong cash ideas.

text.p: Expectations that cash lumber markets will remain strong for the near term boosted lumber futures up the daily limit and set new contract highs in holiday-lightened activity, traders said.
November was up limit at $385.70 per tbf, January was at $394.50 and March at $394.10. All but November posted a new contract high on the advance.

Trading activity was thin due to the Columbus Day holiday in the United States and Thanksgiving Day in Canada and futures worked their way up the limit on ideas that cash lumber will remain strong, traders said.
There was continued concern over the quota on Canadian lumber. Also, technically the market was seen testing the $402 per tbf area in November and $412 area in January, they added.
